title: Harissa-Hinted Egyptian Lamb Tagine
description: A low-glycemic twist on traditional Egyptian tagine with tender lamb, infused with the warmth of harissa and subtle sweetness of dried apricots.
instructions: Preheat the agave-leaf vessel by grilling over binchotan charcoal at 200°C (400°F) for 10 minutes.
Season the lamb shoulder with salt and black pepper.
Sear the lamb shoulder in olive oil until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Sauté the onion, garlic, and ginger in olive oil until softened.
Add the harissa spice blend and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb shoulder, dried apricots, and lemon juice to the agave-leaf vessel.
Cover the vessel and cook for 2 hours at 150°C (300°F).
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
